authority.note: This run follows the time-coordinate preflight repair and is the CRQ authority. Earlier CRQ artifacts are superseded preflight evidence.

scientific_interpretation: The three equilibrium histories per coarse geometry are numerically qualified and invariant across the temporal-refinement ladder.
Temporal subdivision alone does not qualify any dynamic D3 or D2 coarse-Richards history, even at 16 substeps per 0.0008-day observation interval.
Therefore the equal-state-dimension dynamic coarse-Richards comparator is unavailable under the current strict Reference numerical authority.
This cannot be interpreted as LARE outperforming coarse Richards; it is a comparator-qualification blocker.
LARE may still be characterized against fine Reference Richards on its common physical domain.
valid_next_question: Determine whether standard LARE closure error is primarily resolution-driven using the already-preregistered D4 control, and separately decide whether a higher-dimensional conventional Richards viability curve is scientifically useful.
